title: Does a Language Server Save Tokens for Coding Agents? A Measurement Methodology and Preliminary Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.13568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents spend most of their context budget on retrieval. Lexical retrieval (grep) is universal, instant, and zero-setup, but noisy: it cannot tell a definition from a call from a comment. Semantic retrieval via the Language Server Protocol (LSP) is precise and typed, but needs a running, indexed server and pays a per-symbol round-trip. The claim that semantic retrieval is more token-efficient is, we find, asserted almost everywhere and measured almost nowhere: no public source isolates the LSP-vs-lexical token delta for an agent at equal task-success. This paper formalizes the question with one metric (tokens-to-success), specifies a five-arm ablation isolating semantic retrieval from confounds, maps three pre-stated failure modes onto measurable variables, and reports a preliminary study (Python and TypeScript repos; Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5). translated_title: 语言服务器能为编程代理节省令牌吗？一种测量方法论与初步研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13568v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：编程代理将大部分上下文预算用于检索。词法检索（grep）是通用的、即时的、零设置的，但噪声大：它无法区分定义、调用和注释。通过语言服务器协议（LSP）进行的语义检索是精确且类型化的，但需要运行中的、已索引的服务器，并付出每个符号往返的代价。我们发现，语义检索更节省令牌的说法几乎到处被断言，却几乎无处被测量：没有公开来源在任务成功率相等的情况下，单独隔离出LSP与词法检索对代理的令牌差异。本文用单一指标（成功所需令牌数）形式化了这个问题，指定了一个五臂消融实验来隔离语义检索与混淆因素，将三个预先声明的失败模式映射到可测量变量，并报告了一项初步研究（Python和TypeScript仓库；Claude Opus 4.8、Sonnet 4.6、Haiku 4.5）。答案是条件性的，且通常是负面的。在符号命名的本地化任务上，...
tldr: 本文提出了一种测量方法论和初步研究，首次在任务成功率相等条件下量化了语义检索（LSP）与词法检索（grep）对编程代理的令牌消耗差异，发现语义检索通常并不节省令牌，且效果是条件性的。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes a measurement methodology and preliminary study to quantify, for the first time, the token consumption difference between semantic retrieval (LSP) and lexical retrieval (grep) for coding agents at equal task success, finding that semantic retrieval is usually not more token-efficient and the outcome is conditional.
